question: For a Roth IRA distribution of earnings to be fully tax-free as a qualified distribution, is reaching age 59½ alone enough, or must the account also satisfy the 5-year holding rule?
true_option: Both age 59½ and the 5-year holding rule must be satisfied
false_option: Age 59½ alone is enough regardless of how long the account has been open
true_claim_text: both age 59 and a half and the 5-year rule are required
false_claim_text: age 59 and a half alone makes earnings tax-free
source: IRS Publication 590-B: a qualified Roth IRA distribution requires the 5-taxable-year holding period in addition to a qualifying event such as reaching age 59½.
